headlines.title: Stock Market Today: Dow, S&P Rise Before Warsh Speech; Marvell, Affirm, PayPal Are Big Movers (Live Coverage)
headlines.summary: Stocks were mixed while Treasury yields edged higher before Fed chief Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech. Marvell, Affirm, PayPal are big movers.

headlines.title: PayPal Sinks 15% as Stripe and Advent Abandon $50B Buyout, Affirm Soars 13% on ‘Most Profitable Quarter Ever’
headlines.summary: A collapsed $50 billion buyout sent shockwaves through the buy-now-pay-later sector Friday morning, splitting two of digital payments' biggest names into opposite directions while the broader financials market barely flinched.

headlines.title: PayPal Stock Drops 14% on Bid Collapse. 2 Reasons to Believe It Can Come Back.
headlines.summary: PayPal stock was diving on a report that takeover talks have ended but there is still reason for optimism.

headlines.title: Dow Jones Futures: Fed Chief Warsh Speech Due; Marvell, Affirm, PayPal, Elastic Are Big Movers
headlines.summary: Fed chief Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech looms. Affirm, Marvell, PayPal and Elastic are big movers on news. Nvidia and several software stocks flashed buy signals Thursday.

headlines.title: PayPal Dives As Advent-Stripe Group Said To Drop Pursuit Of Payments Giant
headlines.summary: PayPal stock dived overnight after the Advent-Stripe consortium reportedly dropped their pursuit of the digital payments giant.

description: PayPal Holdings, Inc. operates a technology platform that enables digital payments for merchants and consumers worldwide. The company operates a two-sided network at scale that connects merchants and consumers that enables its customers to connect, transact, and send and receive payments through online and in person, as well as transfer and withdraw funds using various funding sources, such as bank accounts, PayPal or Venmo account balance, consumer credit and debit products, credit and debit cards, and cryptocurrencies, as well as other stored value products, including gift cards and eligible rewards. It provides payment solutions under the PayPal, PayPal Credit, Braintree, Venmo, Xoom, Hyperwallet, Honey, and Paidy names. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
